summary: Fixed next_id returning incorrect ID when todos have non-sequential or negative IDs

implementation_details.todo_from_dict_validation: Added validation in Todo.from_dict to reject non-positive IDs (zero or negative) with clear error message
implementation_details.next_id_fix: Modified next_id to filter todos to only positive IDs before computing max, returning 1 when no positive IDs exist
implementation_details.test_compatibility_fix: Updated test_storage_atomicity.py to use worker_id + 1 as base_id to ensure positive IDs (worker_id can be 0)

linter.command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py src/flywheel/todo.py tests/

risks: Existing data with negative or zero IDs will now fail to load via Todo.from_dict - this is intentional data validation
